001package org.clafer.graph;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.HashMap;
005import java.util.HashSet;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Map;
008import java.util.Set;
009import java.util.Stack;
010import java.util.stream.Collectors;
011import org.clafer.collection.Counter;
012
013/**
014 *
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class GraphUtil {
018
019    private GraphUtil() {
020    }
021
022    private static <V> boolean findPath(Vertex<V> cur, Vertex<V> end, Graph<V> graph, Set<Vertex<V>> visited) {
023        if (cur.equals(end)) {
024            return true;
025        }
026        if (!visited.add(cur)) {
027            return false;
028        }
029        for (Vertex<V> neighbour : cur.getNeighbours()) {
030            if (findPath(neighbour, end, graph, visited)) {
031                return true;
032            }
033        }
034        return false;
035    }
036
037    private static <V> void findPath(Vertex<V> cur, Graph<V> graph, Set<Vertex<V>> visited) {
038        if (!visited.add(cur)) {
039            return;
040        }
041        for (Vertex<V> neighbour : cur.getNeighbours()) {
042            findPath(neighbour, graph, visited);
043        }
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Checks if there exists a path in the graph from the start node to the end
048     * node.
049     *
050     * @param <V> the type of the data
051     * @param start the start node
052     * @param end the end node
053     * @param graph the directed graph
054     * @return {@code true} if there is a path in the graph from the start node
055     * to the end node, {@code false} otherwise
056     */
057    public static <V> boolean hasPath(Vertex<V> start, Vertex<V> end, Graph<V> graph) {
058        Set<Vertex<V>> visited = new HashSet<>();
059        return findPath(start, end, graph, visited);
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * Compute all the reachable nodes from the set of start nodes.
064     *
065     * @param <V> the type of the data
066     * @param start the start nodes
067     * @param graph the directed graph
068     * @return all the reachable nodes from the set of start nodes
069     */
070    public static <V> Set<V> reachable(Set<Vertex<V>> start, Graph<V> graph) {
071        Set<Vertex<V>> visited = new HashSet<>();
072        for (Vertex<V> vertex : start) {
073            findPath(vertex, graph, visited);
074        }
075        return visited.stream().map(Vertex<V>::getData).collect(Collectors.toSet());
076    }
077
078    /**
079     * Compute the strongly connected components in the graph in topological
080     * order. Implementation of Tarjan's algorithm.
081     *
082     * @param <V> the type of the data
083     * @param graph the directed graph
084     * @return the strongly connected components in topological order.
085     * @see <a
086     * href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tarjan%27s_strongly_connected_components_algorithm">Tarjan's
087     * algorithm</a>
088     */
089    public static <V> List<Set<V>> computeStronglyConnectedComponents(Graph<V> graph) {
090        Counter counter = new Counter();
091        Map<Vertex<V>, Index> vertexIndices = new HashMap<>();
092        Stack<Vertex<V>> S = new Stack<>();
093        List<Set<V>> components = new ArrayList<>();
094
095        for (Vertex<V> vertex : graph.getVertices()) {
096            if (!vertexIndices.containsKey(vertex)) {
097                strongConnect(vertex, counter, vertexIndices, S, components);
098            }
099        }
100        return components;
101    }
102
103    private static <V> Index strongConnect(Vertex<V> vertex, Counter counter, Map<Vertex<V>, Index> vertexIndices,
104            Stack<Vertex<V>> S, List<Set<V>> components) {
105        int index = counter.next();
106        Index vertexIndex = new Index(index, index);
107        vertexIndices.put(vertex, vertexIndex);
108
109        S.push(vertex);
110
111        for (Vertex<V> neighbour : vertex.getNeighbours()) {
112            Index neighbourIndex = vertexIndices.get(neighbour);
113            if (neighbourIndex == null) {
114                neighbourIndex = strongConnect(neighbour, counter, vertexIndices, S, components);
115                vertexIndex.setLowIndexMin(neighbourIndex.getLowIndex());
116            } else if (S.contains(neighbour)) {
117                vertexIndex.setLowIndexMin(neighbourIndex.getIndex());
118            }
119        }
120
121        if (vertexIndex.getLowIndex() == vertexIndex.getIndex()) {
122            Set<V> component = new HashSet<>();
123
124            Vertex<V> cycle;
125            do {
126                cycle = S.pop();
127                component.add(cycle.getData());
128            } while (cycle != vertex);
129
130            components.add(component);
131        }
132        return vertexIndex;
133    }
134
135    private static class Index {
136
137        private final int index;
138        private int lowIndex;
139
140        Index(int index, int lowIndex) {
141            this.index = index;
142            this.lowIndex = lowIndex;
143        }
144
145        int getIndex() {
146            return index;
147        }
148
149        int getLowIndex() {
150            return lowIndex;
151        }
152
153        void setLowIndexMin(int lowIndex) {
154            if (this.lowIndex >= lowIndex) {
155                this.lowIndex = lowIndex;
156            }
157        }
158    }
159}
